verses.pali: “Yo, bhikkhave, rūpaṁ abhinandati, dukkhaṁ so abhinandati.
verses.english: “Mendicants, if you take pleasure in form, you take pleasure in suffering.

verses.pali: Yo dukkhaṁ abhinandati, ‘aparimutto so dukkhasmā’ti vadāmi.
verses.english: If you take pleasure in suffering, you’re not free from suffering, I say.
If you take pleasure in feeling …

verses.pali: yo viññāṇaṁ abhinandati, dukkhaṁ so abhinandati.
verses.english: consciousness, you take pleasure in suffering.

verses.pali: Yo dukkhaṁ abhinandati, ‘aparimutto so dukkhasmā’ti vadāmi.
verses.english: If you take pleasure in suffering, you’re not free from suffering, I say.

verses.pali: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, rūpaṁ nābhinandati, dukkhaṁ so nābhinandati.
verses.english: If you don’t take pleasure in form, you don’t take pleasure in suffering.

verses.pali: Yo dukkhaṁ nābhinandati, ‘parimutto so dukkhasmā’ti vadāmi.
verses.english: If you don’t take pleasure in suffering, you’re free from suffering, I say.
If you don’t take pleasure in feeling …

verses.pali: yo viññāṇaṁ nābhinandati, dukkhaṁ so nābhinandati.
verses.english: consciousness, you don’t take pleasure in suffering.

verses.pali: Yo dukkhaṁ nābhinandati, ‘parimutto so dukkhasmā’ti vadāmī”ti.
verses.english: If you don’t take pleasure in suffering, you’re free from suffering, I say.”
